'''Ony Bobissia''' was a [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] who was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> By that [[Time/Legends|time]], Bobissia had become a regular at the eatery [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="CSWE I 82">{{CSWECite|I|82|Bobissia, Ony}}.</ref> and one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] outside of the diner, the Triffian chatted with a [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] named [[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Slyther Bushforb]].<ref name="AoC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ony Bobissia was created for the [[2002]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], where the character appears very briefly. Bobissia's digital model was a retooling of the digital model used for the character [[Ebe E. Endocott/Legends|Ebe E. Endocott]], who appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|previous film]].<ref name="DB" />
